svg.title: How a gold nanoparticle sheet forms on a water droplet
svg.desc: Illustration, not to scale. Three side views of a water droplet on a PTFE block. First, ligand-coated gold nanoparticles in an organic solvent are placed beside the droplet. Second, the particles climb onto the water and spread over its surface. Third, the solvent has evaporated and the particles form a solid sheet one particle thick; an inset shows the sheet from above as a hexagonal array whose ligand shells interlock.
